title: The Grown-Up Spelling Bee
story: Four grown-ups made it to the final round of the library's spelling bee, each given one fiendish word and each clutching a lucky charm. Wren spelled in a whisper, as usual, and Mabel judged with her red pencil poised. Then Mabel's score sheet slipped under the cookie table and came out with a coffee ring on it. Who spelled which word, and which charm did each finalist hold?

texts: Of the finalist with the acorn and the finalist with the wishbone, one spelled kayak and the other spelled zucchini.
The finalist who spelled rhythm clutched either the sea glass or the wishbone.
The finalist with the sea glass is either Cyrus or Oscar.
Wren spelled either zucchini or rhythm.
Of Oscar and Imani, one clutched the wishbone and the other clutched the sea glass.
